headline: Coinbase wins final OCC trust charter

scenes.vo: Coinbase just got final sign off from a federal banking regulator for its own national trust company. Here's what changed.
Coinbase says the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency gave final approval to Coinbase National Trust Company. It got conditional approval back in April.
Here's why traders are watching it. Coinbase custody for big institutions now sits under one federal regulator. Circle and Ripple already hold the same kind of charter.
The catch? This is not a regular bank. Coinbase says it won't take retail deposits, and a community bank group is suing the regulator over these charters.
Here's what happens next. Watch that lawsuit, and whether more crypto firms win the same approval.
